notes.title: 0.6.6 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

firstly we'd like to apologize for the absolute disappearance of us with The Lost. We'll be upfront with you. We have been working on updates lately, but we just couldn't get it right and the way we wanted it. Finally a few weeks ago we made a decision we believe will be good for the overall development of the game.

We decided to remove multiplayer for the time being, and focus on everything else, then add multiplayer back on 1.0 release. This decision came after we ran into trouble with networking some features.

Our next update will be released in the next few months with much of our promised features we aimed to deliver months ago. Thank you for your continued support.

The Fumeblast team

notes.title: 0.6.5 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello Survivalists, it's update time!

First of all, we'd like to apologize for the long months without any updates or news from us. We realize that it wasn't the right move to leave you all out. BUT, we do have exciting news, more updates are on the way!

So, now the patch notes for 0.6.5:

NEW
A new map has been released. Out with the old and in with the new!
- We realize this might come off as sudden but we believe this was the only way to keep the flow of the game, along with more opportunities for mass things in the future.

We have updated the zombies beta mode to strengthen the zombies, along with spread them out more across the map.

IMPROVEMENTS
We have made mass optimization improvements to fix FPS issues, especially on high end computers. The average FPS on a 3060 Ti before the update on ultra was 32. The new average is 130!

FIXES
We have fixed a tree chopping issue where it caused a good amount of trees from being impossible to chop down.

We have fixed a glitch where sometimes the player would glitch and pass-through a tree and die.

That is all for the update, but don't worry, we have more planned! We are currently on track to release 0.7.0 in the next 2 months. Along with that, we are taking part in the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest, taking place from Feb 10th-17th.

Until next time survivalists!

Watch the video showcasing the new map now, and get ready to play!

notes.title: 0.6.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello survivalists,

Our first big update is here for The Lost, update 0.6.0. Here are the full patch notes:

NEW

Zombie Mode: Introduced a new Zombie Mode with 5 waves and increasing difficulty. (Please note that this mode is a beta, as all modes are until full release. So expect bugs and issues)

Saving System: Implemented a robust saving system. Players can now save player data in the world, and hosts can save world data.

In-Game Chat Box: Included an in-game chat box for player communication.

Player Revival: Added the ability to revive players.

Items: Added rarity level which coincide with spawn rates

Wieldables: Healing items

Wieldables: Throwable items

New crafting display system: all items that are craftable are now displayed on the left of your screen when the inventory is open.

IMPROVEMENTS

Optimization improvements have been made with reducing memory that trees, rocks, and the building system takes up.

Settings menu: You can now change graphics, audio, general, and input settings.

Main Menu: We've redesigned the menu to look more simple and stylish.

UI: We've made changes to HUD and UI to display more information easily and simpler.

Sleep and day-night cycle system: We've made improvements to the sleep system and day-night cycle syncing

World Space Player Info: Displays player info on top of their characters.

FIXES

Third-Person Clothing: Fixed issues where pre-equipped clothes were not displaying.

Room Name Update: Corrected the room name not updating properly.

Missing Crate Items: Resolved issues with items missing from crates.

Animation Sync: Fixed synchronization issues with animations.

Item Dropping: Addressed crashes occurring when dropping items.

Item Pickup: Fixed a bug where player was able to pickup an item multiple times due to unstable connection.

ROADMAP

Here is our updated and current roadmap for right now. These are just an overview of a few huge things we plan to do. They are subject to change for the moment:
https://i.postimg.cc/WzJBWPts/Screenshot-2024-09-18-015541.png

Thank you for playing, until next time!

notes.title: 0.5.1 Patch
notes.content:
We've release 0.5.1 to address bugs and issues on release.

-Changed player spawn to further help new players grab initial materials
-Fixed optimization issues for lower end devices
-Increased spawn rate of stone, and metal
-Increased spawn of food, and water

Thank you for the feedback and bug reports, we will continue to monitor and update as needed!

Thank you!

notes.title: THE LOST EARLY ACCESS AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! 

We are thrilled to announce that The Lost is finally out and ready for you to dive into its mysterious and enchanting world. After years of hard work, sleepless nights, and countless cups of coffee, our team has poured their hearts and souls into crafting an unforgettable experience for you.

WATCH THE TRAILER HERE: 
[previewyoutube=7_qvd7gb7QY;full][/previewyoutube]

Game Overview

The Lost is a horror survival game challenging you to survive. Boss fights, animals, weather, and temperature will challenge your survival abilities. The Lost island will challenge everything in your life. Can you survival this unknown world?

Key Features

1. Realistic Survival Mechanics: Manage your character's hunger, thirst, temperature, and stamina. Collect resources, craft tools, and build shelters to stay alive in the unforgiving wilderness. Make crucial decisions about what to eat, where to rest, and how to stay warm during the cold nights.

2. Wildlife Interaction: Encounter a variety of wildlife with their own behaviors and territories. Some animals may be a source of food, while others could pose a threat. Be prepared to face predators, but also learn to read the signs of approaching danger to avoid unnecessary confrontations.

3. Day-Night Cycle: Survive in a dynamic world with a realistic day-night cycle. Utilize the daylight to explore and gather resources, but be cautious as nightfall brings increased danger and challenges.

4. Multiplayer Collaboration: Team up with friends or other players to increase your chances of survival. Work together to build shelters, share resources, and defend against aggressive wildlife. But beware, resources are scarce, and not everyone may have your best interests in mind.

5. Weather Challenges: Face extreme weather conditions, including rain, snowstorms, and heatwaves. Adapt your strategies to overcome these challenges, and use the environment to your advantage.

6. Mystery Events: Encounter unexpected events that add an element of unpredictability to your survival journey. From sudden weather changes to mysterious landmarks, be prepared for anything.

And way more to explore!

Development Journey

Concept and Inspiration

The concept for The Lost was born from our love for challenging survival games and our desire to create something that felt both exciting and fresh. We wanted to design a world that was not only visually stunning but also rich in history and mystery.

Design and Art

Our art team has worked tirelessly to create a world that feels alive and magical. From the towering trees to the smallest details in the forest floor, every element was crafted with care to immerse players in the experience.

Testing and Feedback

Throughout the development process, we’ve conducted extensive playtesting to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments. Our community of testers has been invaluable in helping us refine the game and ensure it meets the high standards we set out to achieve.

Post-Launch Plans

While the game is now live, our journey doesn’t end here. We are committed to supporting The Lost with regular updates, including bug fixes, new content, and community-driven features. Your feedback is crucial, and we encourage you to share your thoughts and experiences with us.

Upcoming Features

- New Areas to Explore: We plan to expand the game world with additional regions, each with its own unique challenges and bosses, and more.
- Story Mode: We plan to incorporate a story mode for players to play during early access
- Game modes: We plan to incorporate a bunch of different types of game modes so that players, by themselves or with friends can enjoy different styles
-And a bunch more! We have a lot of plans for this game, stay tuned!

Thank You

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has supported us throughout this journey. From our dedicated team members to our passionate community, The Lost would not have been possible without you. We can’t wait to hear your stories, see your gameplay, and continue this adventure together in early access, and we can't wait for full release!

Happy exploring, and may you find your way in The Lost!

Best regards,  
The Development Team
